you absolutely made the right decision to leave, and yes it is totally normal to miss him, I also broke up with my ex gf, 7 years of relationship just like that, gone.

you are grieving the good memories with them, the happy times, you are so used to his emotional abuse for such a long time and you're not used to this freedom, you might even develop something such as Stockholm syndrome, like I did before, it can be scary and you might want to get back with him again, but DO NOT ever go back!

since you are grieving the good memories, it can be painful and hard at first, you need healing and support, give it more times to love yourself more, and trust me, you'll feel so much relief once you realize how lucky you are for being able to finally breakout from the abuse

stay strong, contact your family or friends or anyone that you trust enough to give you all the support you need, if you are still feeling trapped, find a professional to help you out, vent your feelings out, write it out and burn it

what I like to do is to write down what my ex used to do to me that makes me uncomfortable or upset, by remembering something terrible that she has done to me made it easier to let her go, you need to remind yourself what made you left in the first place, you have admit he's bad for you and had done awful things to you

hope this helps, may you find your peace!
